summary: Andy Surabian is a Republican strategist who worked on all three Trump campaigns, served as Steve Bannon's political adviser in the first Trump White House, and later advised the pro-Trump Great America Alliance. He was a senior adviser on JD Vance's 2022 Senate race, ran Vance's vice-presidential campaign operation in 2024, and is a close political adviser to Donald Trump Jr.
